title: Proof-Carrying Certificates for LLM Pipelines: A Trust-Boundary Architecture
why_relevant: Proposes Lean 4 proof-carrying certificates for LLM pipelines, including conflict-aware grounding, abstention operators, and prompt-injection-resistant agent actions, which touches on calibration/control and adversarial robustness in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is formal verification architecture rather than RAG robustness per se; empirical pilots are limited and the work is largely orthogonal to mainstream robust-RAG literature.
